Oneliner

Earth observation constellation with a resolution of 2.5 meters per pixel.
Description

Global Earth monitoring system. The Griffon project, initiated by Roscosmos , includes a constellation of 136 ultra-small cubsat satellites with a resolution of 2.5 meters per pixel. It is planned that the full orbital grouping will be deployed between 2024 and 2026.
